title: La Ma Teodora - Cuba Musical 1929
edition: Cuba musical, Havana, Imprenta de Molina y Compañía, 1929, printed p. 25
scope: All five systems, including the four written echoes and final rest.
editorial: One flat in the key signature (B-flat). Encode the initial quarter plus eighth as a 36-tick pickup in 6/8.
Read each bracketed three-quarter figure as a complete 6/8 bar with three equal 24-tick attacks against two dotted-quarter beats.
Hold the fermata in bar 9 for its nominal quarter length. Preview tempo is editorial: dotted quarter = 72, equivalent to MIDI quarter = 108.
Use the four responses already written across systems 4–5. No extra repeat is added for the text below the notation.
MIDI dynamics are editorial velocity equivalents. The p, pp and two ppp signs take effect on the late chord in bars 13, 15, 17 and 19.
